messages:
anika: Quick sync — proposing a 3-week 'Optimize convergence' sprint to unify batching / caching / quantization recommendations with eval-triggered alerts. Goal: produce an advisor prototype + pilot acceptance checklist. Thoughts?
kevin: +1 to a focused sprint. question: do we split infra (batching runtime) vs recommendations (advice + UI)?
maya: we should surface cost delta per suggestion. customers will ask for expected $/token impact.
dinesh: suggest we make eval hooks first-class: triggers can be thresholded on stewarded prompts and drift signals. example rule: "if top-k agreement < 0.7 over 1k requests -> alert"
lina: hearing from two pilots (AcmeHealth, Playwell): they want tenant-aware quant recs and fallbacks when quality regresses. also need rollback playbook.
kevin: agree on tenant profiles. For scope, propose MVP = advisor API + UI card + eval alert webhook. No backend recompiler work.
anika: proposed launch criteria (draft): p95 latency impact of advisor < +20ms, median cost improvement >= 12% vs baseline on pilot workloads, eval alert FPR < 5%.
man: can we add a simple simulation harness to estimate cost before applying?
dinesh: yes — we can run offline replay of 24h traffic and produce expected token counts and latency delta. I can mock this in a notebook.
kevin: rough proto batching policy we can ship for pilot:
```json
{
  "mode": "latency-first",
  "max_batch_size": 24,
  "max_wait_ms": 45,
  "kv_cache_ttl_ms": 120000
}
```
kevin: that plus quant suggestion (int8 vs int4) with per-tenant quality baseline should be enough to recommend.
maya: ops request: dashboard metric set = cost_delta, p50/p95 latency, model-concordance, alerts-fired. retention 30d for pilot.
lina: customer asks to see recommendations as "what changed" diff and a revert button. please account UX.
anika: action items: 1) anika - spec PR with acceptance criteria by Wed EOD, 2) kevin - engineering spike + proto batching config by Fri, 3) dinesh - eval hooks POC + replay harness by Fri, 4) maya - dashboard telemetry list + sample queries by Mon, 5) lina - collect pilot acceptance signoff template by Mon.
kevin: blockers: need a small quota for replay runs on dedicated cluster. cc @infra-team.
zephyr-bot: deploy-bot: reminder — no infra changes should be scheduled during sprint kickoff window 2109994400-2109998000.
dinesh: one more thought — make eval-triggered alerts include suggested remediation (e.g., roll to previous quant config or switch to non-quantized variant). reduces ops churn.
anika: love that. ok if everyone can ack here we’ll lock scope and I’ll open the PR. :+1: :thumbsup:
kevin: ack
maya: ack
dinesh: ack
lina: ack
zephyr-bot: anika added spec-draft.pdf to the thread (link: https://redwood.dev/specs/optimize-convergence)
